summary: Created one embodied-AI and humanoid component-supply-chain idea. evidence.source: International Federation of Robotics, World Robotics 2025
evidence.claim: IFR counted 542,000 industrial robot installations in 2024 and 4.664 million robots in operation, confirming a scaled conventional automation base.

evidence.source: International Federation of Robotics humanoid position paper
evidence.claim: IFR distinguishes the humanoid vision from present deployment reality and highlights opportunities and limitations.
ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa, KUKA, and humanoid developers are integrating NVIDIA simulation, model, and edge-compute tooling across an installed base exceeding two million industrial robots.
NVIDIA introduced a robotics safety stack with Agility as the first humanoid partner, underscoring certification as a deployment gate.
MP reported commercial US magnet production and USD 21.1 million of Magnetics revenue, without separating robotics demand.
